full06.rngVerified: classes.dex CRun.random(short n): state = (state*31415+1) & 0xFFFF, value = (state*n) >>> 16; allocRunHeader seeds rh3Graine = (short)currentTimeMillis (congruent mod 65536); startTheFrame logs 'Starting new frame' at instruction 42 and calls initRunLoop at 231, the caller logs 'startTheFrame() called' after it returns -- the bracket is where the model assumed
